notes.title: UPDATE #20
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31512433/7a30e81ee976b4e5b74ef32a5de265323b338fc0.png[/img]
[b]New update is out! [/b]
Added features:
[list]
[*] [b]Color Blindness options
[*] Table skins[/b]
[/list]
We're now going color blind - friendly!
We've added a setting in options, where users with color blindness can select between Protanopia, Protanomaly, Deuteranopia, Deuteranomaly, Tritanopia, Tritanomaly, Achromatopsia, and Achromatomaly. We really hope this makes the game just a little bit more accessible!
Another addition in this patch are [b]table skins[/b], which also can be enabled or disabled in game settings. If you have a VIP membership, you can add just a little extra oomph to your gameplay by enabling table skins. Also other players, who are not VIP members will see your skins so you can show off a little bit!
Thanks for playing everyone and good luck!

tags.feature: [b]Color Blindness options
[b]table skins[/b]

notes.title: Update #18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31512433/5abdad014df9f0f9215593b6468cacfb26a1a7dd.jpg[/img]

We are now enforcing new Steam users to create Magic Nations account (aka PrimeBit Games Account) the first time they are playing.
This may seem a bit annoying at first but it is to create a seamless cross-platform experience.
When you have Magic Nations account you can log-in using these credentials on Android and iOS versions and retain your progress.
Existing Steam players don't have to do anything, although they can still create associated PBG account after selecting Profile->Account inside the game if they want to play on mobile.

Notes:

* If you want to play cross-platform with Nintendo Switch please contact support@primebitgames.com and we will help you. Update for Nintendo version is coming so this is a temporary solution.

* If you want to login to PBG account on Steam and have already associated your Steam account with another PBG account please contact support@primebitgames.com and we will help you.

tags.feature: We are now enforcing new Steam users to create Magic Nations account (aka PrimeBit Games Account) the first time they are playing.
When you have Magic Nations account you can log-in using these credentials on Android and iOS versions and retain your progress.

notes.title: Magic Nations Update #13 - October 10th, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31512433/383fe9033f328be23a01756d10734880f1fd1ec1.png[/img]
The following changes have been implemented:
[list]
[*]fixed a bug in a Support Message Dialog Box preventing users from using the Enter button start a new line
[*]changed how player stats are displayed, now battles WON/LOST and percentage ratio to better visualize your account
[*]fixed in which order cards are shuffled
[*]fixed a bug in which an Amazon card protecting nearby cards wouldn't receive any damage while being asleep at the same time
[*]cards which are asleep will automatically awaken when set on fire
[*]cards set on fire can't be put to sleep

[*]changed how the marketplace is accessed to prevent players from creating dummy accounts for the purpose of artificially creating currency on their main accounts, now a player must reach a level 10 in order to be able to use the marketplace
[/list]
We'd like to thank all of the players who contacted us pointing out bugs, errors, and mistakes. We're committed to constantly improving Magic Nations and we couldn't do it without your involvement!

notes.title: Magic Nations is out of Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31512433/a92901d5c684a21d99e946bc9f84252c227b93b2.png[/img]

[h1]We're happy to announce Magic Nations game is out of Early Access![/h1]

Get ready to battle your opponents in Magic Nations, a free-to-play card battle game! Amazons, Necromancers, Dwarves, Humans, Elves, and Orcs are at your command!

With this update, we'd like to present you with a full list of features available for you:
[list]
    [*]All six races are now playable
    [*]Added new cards, abilities, effects, and animations
    [*]Added new visual effects
    [*]First round of Special Gold Cards can be redeemed
    [*]The first Orcs campaign is available
    [*]Complete daily and weekly tasks
    [*]Deck of cards strength depends on the player's level
    [*]Coins can be purchased via Steam Wallet
    [*]Race-specific booster packs are available
    [*]UI fixes, including controller-specific adjustments
    [*]Partial controller support
    [*]Replaced GameJam with E-Sports registration
    [*]Fixed an error where the player could start the game without placing a single card on the table
    [*]Fixed an error involving the 'forgot password' option 
    [*]Added greater compression to reduce the overall game size
    [*]Fixed various internal server errors
    [*]Added new gameplay soundtrack
    [*]Reduced deck limit to only one card from previous twenty
    [*]Fixed a matchmaking error where the player could be matched with another player despite canceling the match
    [*]Remaining ranking tabs are now available
    [*]Negatively affected cards fonts change colors depending on stats being decreased or increased 
    [*]Added the 'draw' outcome. Previously the game could only result in a victory or defeat.
    [*]Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]
[b]Special Gold Cards[/b]

We are expanding the Magic Nations gameplay! By playing our other selected titles you can unlock additional cards and activate them here. For more information visit http://www.magic-nations.com and choose the Redeem tab. The first game is Caveman Chuk shortly followed by Dark Tower.

[b]E-Sports[/b]
We're working on adding a spectator mode to make Magic Nations eSports more friendly. The link allows registering to participate in future on-line and off-line events.

[b]VIP Subscription[/b]
Optional, VIP subscription allows the player to receive the following benefits:
[list]
    [*]additional 1200 Gold
    [*]2X more XP point 
    [*]2X more chance for the card to drop
    [*]special VIP avatar marker visible to all players
[/list]
The subscription is available in 30-day, 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month packages.

[b]Premium DLC[/b]
The first Magic Nations Premium DLC pack is now available! Expand your Magic Nations gameplay experience and get additional 1000 Gold, one neutral Special Gold Card (not associated with any race), and a booster pack!

We hope you enjoy Magic Nations and stay tuned for more updates and content! Feel free to send us your suggestions or comments to support@primebitgames.com

notes.title: Magic Nations Update - January 11th, 2018
notes.content:
* Works on server stability has been completed.
* When playing with bot, player doesn't get experience.
* Player receives penalty experience points if he leaves battle or give ups.
* All players will be kicked during maintenance.
